title: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator
abstract: arXiv:2611.26722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To autonomously execute multi-step tasks, enterprise agents must reliably interact with tools, call APIs, or query databases, making tool-calling a fundamental capability of AI models. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) optimises for producing the correct call, but never contrasts it with a plausible incorrect one. In an environment where even a minor formatting error can invalidate a call and an incorrect decision can derail the interaction, direct preference optimisation (DPO) targets exactly this contrast. DPO, therefore, requires preference pairs rather than plain demonstrations. For tool-calling, such data, especially in realistic multi-turn settings, remains extremely scarce. To address this scarcity, we introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing ~4.5M validated preference pairs, derived from Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M (apache-2.0) conversations. translated_title: TOUMAII：一个包含450万偏好对的大规模工具调用偏好数据集及其源无关生成器
translated_abstract: 为了自主执行多步骤任务，企业级智能体必须可靠地与工具交互、调用API或查询数据库，这使得工具调用成为AI模型的一项基础能力。监督微调（SFT）只优化生成正确的调用，却从未将其与看似合理的错误调用进行对比。在一个即使微小的格式错误也可能使调用失效、错误决策可能导致整个交互脱轨的环境中，直接偏好优化（DPO）恰恰针对这种对比，因此DPO需要偏好对而非简单的演示样本。然而对于工具调用而言，此类数据，尤其是在现实的多轮交互场景中，仍然极其稀缺。为解决这一稀缺性问题，我们提出了TOUMAII，一个大规模工具调用偏好数据集，包含约450万条经过验证的偏好对，这些数据源自Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M（apache-2.0许可）对话。该数据集由多轮和单轮交互组成，并且……
tldr: 该论文提出了包含约450万条经验证偏好对的大规模工具调用偏好数据集TOUMAII及其源无关的偏好对生成器，以缓解工具调用领域（尤其是多轮场景）偏好数据的稀缺，从而支持DPO训练出更可靠的工具调用能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset with ~4.5M validated preference pairs and a source-agnostic preference-pair generator, addressing the scarcity of tool-calling preference data (especially in multi-turn settings) to enable DPO training for more reliable tool-calling.
